rules.label: Tanzania tourist visa fee
rules.note: Fee table loads by script. The guidelines page (https://visa.immigration.go.tz/guidelines) says US passport holders must apply for the Multiple entry visa; a visa on arrival also exists. Tariff table carries no date.

rules.label: Zanzibar mandatory inbound travel insurance, adult fee
rules.body: Embassy of Tanzania in Japan (notice about the Zanzibar scheme)
rules.note: The fee appears only in the Japanese section of the embassy notice; the Zanzibar portal itself shows no fee on the pages that could be read. Child rate and under-3 exemption are not confirmed on any official page.

rules.label: Zanzibar mandatory inbound travel insurance, maximum cover period
rules.body: Zanzibar inbound insurance portal (official application site)
rules.note: FAQ: cover is valid for a maximum of 92 consecutive days and is non-renewable; after 92 days a new policy must be bought.
